sources: Aburrey's Legacy (3 pieces). rmxlinux Json/SkillData/passive_equipsuit_atk_01 (SkillPatchTable level 1: dmg_up 0.24, atk_up 0.05, duration 15): cardAttributeModifier attrs 32/33/28 +dmg_up (battle, combo, ultimate DMG) are stat-panel modifiers.
